WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Trends in woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Trends in woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Trends in woodwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Trends in woodwork.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Woodworking Machines, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Woodworking Machines.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Woodworking Machines.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Woodworking Machines.

5. When learning Portable Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Portable Power Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Portable Power Tools.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Portable Power Tools.

6. When learning Health and Safety in the Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and Safety in the Workshop.

7. When learning Manufactured boards, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Manufactured boards.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Manufactured boards.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Manufactured boards.

8. When learning Finishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Finishing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Finishing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Finishing.

9. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Drawing.

10. When learning Detailed drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Detailed drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Detailed drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Detailed drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

12. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Mass Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Mass Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Finishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Project activity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Detailed drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.

2. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. B — CPU

4. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.

10. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.

11. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.
